packageRules.description: Override shared config: minor updates aren't guaranteed non-breaking (e.g. Django/Wagtail), so split them out of the patch automerge group into their own manually-reviewed PRs
Django/Wagtail ecosystem packages are tightly coupled, so give each its own PR on minor updates rather than grouping with each other or with unrelated packages
Don't auto-update docker-compose service image versions (e.g. postgres) - these are pinned deliberately for local dev
Don't auto-update the postgres service container image used in GitHub Actions workflows - it's pinned to match the local dev/production version
